name: sign-target-dots
title: Sign: target (dots)
description: A sign for "aim", drawn as dots.

files.content:
"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import { Sign, type SignProps } from "@/components/ui/sign"
import type { SignShape } from "@/lib/0db/sign-shapes"

const shape: SignShape = {
  "word": "aim",
  "line": [
    [
      [
        "O",
        12,
        12,
        10,
        0,
        360
      ]
    ],
    [
      [
        "O",
        12,
        12,
        6,
        0,
        360
      ]
    ],
    [
      [
        "O",
        12,
        12,
        2,
        0,
        360
      ]
    ]
  ]
}

function SignTargetDots(props: Omit<SignProps, "shape" | "variant">) {
  return <Sign shape={shape} variant="dots" {...props} />
}

export { SignTargetDots, shape }
